ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white distal lobes with a solid black central peduncle and superior margin. Left lobe contains a distinct dark circular spot in the upper quadrant and a horizontal dark line. Right lobe contains a thin, vertical crescentic mark near the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; extreme irregularity at the distal tips corresponding to node clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep along the lower boundaries terminating in acute, upward-pointing lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of irregular circular protrusions (barnacle colonies) located on the distal-most points of both the left and right lobes; isolated dark circular spot on the left lobe's white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark horizontal linear disruption on the left lobe; vertical parallel rake marks visible at the transitional boundary between black and white pigment on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the trailing lateral edges of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique crescent-shaped pigmentation mark on the right lobe, oriented vertically near the lateral edge.
